fx_note_2026.note: approximate Aug-2026 rates for threshold screening only

meta.egress_note: This routine's environment blocks direct access to procurement portals (TED, Find-a-Tender, SAM.gov, etenders.gov.za, AAI, CIAL, ComprasMX, MERX, etc.) via egress policy. Notice existence & metadata come from web-search snippets; attachment accessibility and exact live open/closed status CANNOT be verified on-portal. To enable attachment/RFP verification, allowlist these hosts or run this routine in an environment without portal egress restrictions.

runs.note: baseline — first run, no prior state to diff against; egress policy blocked direct attachment download so attachment accessibility is inferred
